title: Semantic RT and Debt Residue Projection
goal: Project the canonical RT core into the live current-state capsule and surface governed debt blockers and historical residue as structured runtime records.

problem.current_state: The DB governance runtime exposes current-state, authority, and debt surfaces, but the live capsule does not yet carry the semantic RT projection and structured residue views required to fully collapse the top runtime debt.
problem.gap: Agents still need to infer the canonical RT core and the runtime debt residue structure from multiple surfaces instead of reading a single governed projection.

objectives: Expose the canonical RT core and meta bindings directly in the current-state capsule.
Project debt items into structured blocker and residue views.
Mark the top DB governance/runtime views debt as resolved without duplicating registry content.
acceptance_criteria: current-state output includes the canonical RT projection.
debt runtime output includes structured blocker and residue projections.
DEBT_DB_GOVERNANCE_RUNTIME_VIEWS_001 is resolved in the registry.
global_validate.py reports no new validation regressions from the runtime projection change.

warnings: Follow-on governance/runtime debt remains open in DEBT_DB_GOVERNANCE_RUNTIME_STATE_002 and DEBT_DB_GOVERNANCE_RUNTIME_EVENT_REPLAY_006.
